change_summary: When one authorized Work Model update also carries clearly related selected attachments, preserve those sources and reconcile evidence plus topology in one organization mission without weakening the attachment-consent boundary.

canonical_skill.note: The canonical Skill composes an already-authorized Work Model correction with clearly related selected attachments so the Host cannot complete only topology and silently omit new evidence.

server_contract.note: Contract 2026-09-15.5 adds the same-turn evidence-and-topology route to MCP guidance while preserving Agent-owned planning and typed Runtime receipts.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to 1.7.45 without changing transport, trust, consent, or compatibility-family boundaries.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace/Admin CLI remain at 0.1.0-beta.32; registry-backed update checks return an exact install command plus post-install verification, and Workspace capabilities expose server-owned limits.

help_center.note: Public guidance explains that related selected evidence travels with an authorized Work Model update while attachment presence alone remains no-write.

package_setup.note: Setup and SessionStart make the compound evidence-and-topology route visible without turning arbitrary attachments into write consent.

harness_and_mainline.note: The owner history adds the live relationship-update plus attachment omission and keeps its repair in Host decision order rather than Runtime semantic enforcement.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party 1.7.45 publication and hashes can be verified here; Claude directory acceptance and fresh secondary-host behavior remain external receipts.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover the same-turn compound trigger, adapter convergence, ordinary-attachment and local-only countercases, package export, and localized Help; the failed J2T3 receipt and fresh rerun are the live behavior gate.
